Own (aka pwn) is 1337-speak for dominating another player character or mob. Very few people actually use the term own; it is (essentially) invariably purposely spelled "pwn", although in speech they would probably pronounce it "pown" (or "pone") — though the correct pronunciation would be "poon" based on the fact there are no vowels in the word. Many players will use "pwn" or the past tense "pwned", "pwnd", or "pwnt" jokingly. The word is also purposefully used incorrectly as a noun, "That battle was pwnage!" or in a noun-phrase "I am The Pwnage!" Examples: * "I pwned that goretusk!" * "U dueld me now I pwn you!" Overhealing is the concept of healing more than is required. For example, if a player has 3000 out of 5000 hit points, and the healer heals for 4000, that healer has overhealed for 2000, meaning that 50% of the amount healed was overhealing. Slight overhealing is always to be expected, usually ranging from 10-30% depending on the encounter and the spells used. Higher overhealing than that is generally undesirable, as the healer spent mana on healing that was not needed and which never actually restored health to the target, as it was already at full health. Overtuned is term used for a boss designed to do a lot of damage that your up to date gear would not be able to support. This would usually lead to a nerf on the boss in question. Most of the time they are intentional.

Overturned Kor'kron Caravans wind up all over the Northern Barrens and offer an easy supply of lumber, meat, stone or oil to the first scavengers to get there. Caravan spills are announced by a zone-wide emote describing the location of the spill and the contents of the caravan. Each overturned caravan will drop the material usually near the camp where they are obtained from naturally and will have around 60 crates/barrels containing 1-2 of the item. This makes each caravan holding a possible 120 items.

This is necessary to get the achievement With a Little Helper from My Friends. For , Little Helpers can be purchased to add a PX-238 Winter Wondervolt (complete with Wonderform Operator) to your Level 3 garrison, enabling access all year round and opens up the achievement beyond the Feast of Winter Veil.

The Pack Kodo is a kodo caravan delivering supplies for Vol'jin's rebellion. Escorted by several Astranaar Caravan Leaders or Northwatch Caravan Leaders, with Pack Mules tagging along, attacked by a stream of Kor'kron Caravan Raiders. The caravan can be healed to recover any damage inflicted to it by the mounted raiders. Escorting a caravan to it's intended destination will award a crate of Surplus Supplies.
